description: Performance trend contract. Local create-pr and merge lanes keep threshold budgets blocking; trend deltas are reviewed on approved reference hardware so ordinary developer machines do not fail solely because of local timing noise.

blocking_policy.create_pr: validate benchmark schema, trend policy, stale-baseline policy, and smoke budgets
blocking_policy.merge: enforce stable representative threshold budgets and trend policy; trend deltas remain reference-hardware reviewed
blocking_policy.nightly_release: produce trend deltas on approved reference hardware and require owner review for regressions
blocking_policy.local_trend_delta: do not fail local developer machines solely because of noisy trend deltas
blocking_policy.checked_in_baseline_updates: only approved reference runs may update checked-in trend baselines
